registry_product_kind_binding.name: registry_product_kind_binding
registry_product_kind_binding.value: ("control_plane"."registry_product"."product"='dms' AND "control_plane"."registry_product"."application_id" IS NULL) OR ("control_plane"."registry_product"."product"='turnstile' AND "control_plane"."registry_product"."application_id" IS NOT NULL)

registry_product_approval_dates.name: registry_product_approval_dates
registry_product_approval_dates.value: ("control_plane"."registry_product"."first_approved_at" IS NULL AND "control_plane"."registry_product"."last_approved_at" IS NULL) OR ("control_plane"."registry_product"."first_approved_at" IS NOT NULL AND "control_plane"."registry_product"."last_approved_at" IS NOT NULL AND "control_plane"."registry_product"."first_approved_at"<="control_plane"."registry_product"."last_approved_at")

pairing_consumption_complete.name: pairing_consumption_complete
pairing_consumption_complete.value: ("control_plane"."pairing"."consumed_at" IS NULL AND "control_plane"."pairing"."request_id" IS NULL AND "control_plane"."pairing"."input_digest" IS NULL AND "control_plane"."pairing"."receipt" IS NULL) OR ("control_plane"."pairing"."consumed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "control_plane"."pairing"."request_id" IS NOT NULL AND "control_plane"."pairing"."input_digest" IS NOT NULL AND "control_plane"."pairing"."receipt" IS NOT NULL)

module_catalogue_state.name: module_catalogue_state
module_catalogue_state.value: ("control_plane"."module_catalogue"."status"='draft' AND "control_plane"."module_catalogue"."published_at" IS NULL AND "control_plane"."module_catalogue"."proof_digest" IS NULL AND "control_plane"."module_catalogue"."key_id" IS NULL) OR ("control_plane"."module_catalogue"."status"='released' AND "control_plane"."module_catalogue"."published_at" IS NOT NULL AND "control_plane"."module_catalogue"."proof_digest" IS NOT NULL AND "control_plane"."module_catalogue"."key_id" IS NOT NULL)
